record.question: Who has won the 86th Senior Snooker National Championship?
record.explanation: Answer D: Pankaj Advani. Pankaj Advani won the 2019 senior men’s national snooker championship at Indore, beating Laxman Rawat. The Billiards and Snooker Association of Maharashtra’s own 17 March 2019 tournament report identifies Advani as the reigning national snooker champion; Cue Sports India’s year-by-year results list independently records him as 2019 winner and Rawat as runner-up. The contemporaneous 10 February final report specifies that this was the 86 th edition and a 6–0 final. This concerns senior snooker, not a billiards or junior title. Historical/source note: 2019 senior men’s snooker championship. Association identity evidence and published original results corroborate the event; a federation-signed final score sheet was not retrieved. Reference: https://www.bsam.in/articles/advani-rawat-smoothly-cruise-into-semifinals-285.aspx; https://www.cuesportsindia.com/titles/National/5/National-Snooker-Men; https://www.devdiscourse.com/article/sports-games/375991-pankaj-advani-wins-86th-senior-snooker-national-championship. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
